scope: Exact full-doublet exterior contractions on the declared matter carrier; conditional family-blind response and kinetic normalization identities.

basis.Q: e_c wedge e_(3+w), ordered by color then weak component
basis.u_c: (-1)^c times the ordered complementary color two-form
basis.normalization_convention: four-component Dirac Yukawa after charge-conjugating the right Weyl field; Z_q is its right-handed kinetic metric
basis.inner_product: orthonormal ordered exterior monomials; the CAR metric, not an emitted physical kinetic form

equations.full_gram: U(H)^dagger U(H)=D(H)^dagger D(H)=||H||^2 I3; U(H)^dagger D(H)=0
equations.channel_gram: [g_u U,g_d D]^dagger [g_u U,g_d D]=||H||^2 diag(|g_u|^2 I3,|g_d|^2 I3)
equations.Weyl_normalization: For a literal all-left bilinear Q^T Y_W q_c, the left factor is Z_Q^(-T/2); do not apply the Dirac sandwich to Y_W without charge-conjugation conversion.
equations.mass: M_q=v_chart Y_q,can/sqrt(2), conditional on the stated local action and chart convention
equations.shared_metric: Z_Q=Z_q=R>0 and Y_q=g_q R imply Y_q,can=g_q I3/sqrt(Z_H)
equations.effective_higgs_derivative: partial_H K_eff=A_H-B_H D^(-1) C-B D^(-1) C_H+B D^(-1) D_H D^(-1) C

hypotheses: The declared trace-balanced exterior matter carrier C^3 plus C^2 and one weak-block scalar are retained; scalar existence is not newly proved.
The scalar-dependent invariant tensors are the normalized top-form wedge and contraction displayed here. Their action coefficients g_u and g_d remain independent supplied complex scalars.

The physical family attachment is conditional. The restricted direct-contraction model uses only operators I_family tensor O_matter, with family-blind projection and elimination. This is a bounded model, not all operators allowed by the source axioms.

Physical canonical normalization requires positive kinetic matrices from the same local chiral action. The finite CAR inner product alone is not such an emission. The normalization formulas use four-component Dirac Yukawas after charge-conjugation conversion, whereas the displayed exterior tensors use all-left Weyl coefficients.
The displayed canonical trilinear coefficient assumes Higgs-independent kinetic metrics. Higgs-dependent metrics carry additional derivative interactions.
The shared-metric cancellation is an if-then result for Y=g R; it neither selects nor assumes that choice for the physical source.

analytic_proof.tensor_normalization: The ordered exterior monomials are orthonormal. The top-form coefficient is the sign of a permutation or zero. Contracting e_(3+w) with the dual Higgs removes it with its exterior sign. Thus every nonzero color coefficient has magnitude one; the displayed full-doublet matrices follow for arbitrary complex h0,h1.
analytic_proof.color_ward_identity: A colorless Higgs makes the quark color tensor an intertwiner between the two fundamental action fields. Commutation with the six off-diagonal and two diagonal su(3) generators forces a scalar identity. The W3 and W5 components of the geometric u(3) current act on color, not the separate family tensor factor.
analytic_proof.family_closure: (I_F tensor A)(I_F tensor B)=I_F tensor AB, and addition and adjoint preserve this form. If A is invertible its inverse has the same form. A family-blind block Schur complement is I_F tensor (A-B D^-1 C). Positive functional calculus, including a kinetic inverse square root, also preserves this tensor identity. Hence these operations cannot create a family-sensitive vertex from only family-blind inputs.
analytic_proof.gram_cancellation: In the Dirac convention, for positive Hermitian R the unique positive inverse square root satisfies R^-1/2 R R^-1/2=I. The corresponding canonical vielbein congruence also gives the identity; a complex Hermitian control distinguishes this from the incorrect all-left transpose substitution. Equivalently the generalized pencil factors as R(p-hg) and has three identical roots. An ordinary eigenvalue of an unnormalized record Gram matrix is not a physical mass.
analytic_proof.missing_response: Given a differentiable source chiral quadratic kernel and a fixed light/heavy split with invertible heavy block, differentiate its Schur complement using (D^-1)_H=-D^-1 D_H D^-1. This determines the vertex from the same action if that kernel, source state and kinetic metric are emitted. No such source-selected Higgs-dependent kernel is supplied by this certificate.
analytic_proof.proof_grade: analytic finite-dimensional algebra plus executable exact tensor and noncommuting-matrix checks; not a new Lean theorem or a universal source-selection proof
